prompt: I need an API key from StackOne to connect JobAdder. Where do I get one, and what does JobAdder itself need from me?
skill_note: API keys are platform territory; the JobAdder half belongs to stackone-connectors. Either may fire; the outcome is what counts.

fetch.name: fetches-api-keys-page
fetch.note: The API Keys page, or its older path that redirects.

fetch.name: fetches-jobadder-connector-docs
fetch.note: The JobAdder connector page or its OAuth connector-profile guide.

reply.name: mentions-oauth-for-jobadder
reply.note: JobAdder connects through an OAuth 2.0 connector profile.

reference: A StackOne API key is created in the dashboard on the API Keys page and is used to call StackOne's API; it is not what JobAdder needs.
Connecting JobAdder needs an OAuth 2.0 connector profile: register an application in the JobAdder Developer Portal and put its Client ID and Client Secret in the profile.
The JobAdder application must list StackOne's redirect URI, https://api.stackone.com/connect/oauth2/jobadder/callback.
The reply keeps the StackOne API key and the JobAdder OAuth credentials distinct.
